Caltrain（2027 年 1 月 1 日起）：每多跨一个区加收的钱从 $2: Caltrain (from January 1, 2027): the charge for each extra zone goes from $2.25 to $2.50, and a one-zone ride stays $4.00. Adult one-way fares for 1–6 zones are $4.00, $6.50, $9.00, $11.50, $14.00 and $16.50; eligible discount fares are $2.00, $3.25, $4.50, $5.75, $7.00 and $8.25. Adult monthly passes for 1–6 zones are $96, $156, $216, $276, $336 and $396. Youth fares and parking fees do not change.
Caltrain 月票：从 1 月 1 日起，持月票的乘客每次乘车都要上车刷卡、: Caltrain monthly passes: from January 1, monthly pass holders must tap on and tap off for every ride.
Muni（2027 年 1 月 4 日起）：成人单程用 Clipper $3.0: Muni (from January 4, 2027): the adult single ride on Clipper is $3.00 (now $2.85), the M monthly pass $90 and the A pass with BART inside San Francisco $108; under SFMTA’s proposed schedule, MuniMobile stops selling day passes on January 3.

BART 另有一份资金不足时的应急方案（2026 年 2 月董事会初步通过）：没: BART also has a contingency plan for a funding shortfall (initially approved by its Board in February 2026): without new funding, fares and parking fees would rise 30% from January 2027 and up to a cumulative 50% later, with deep service cuts.
